name: idesy-scent
description: Official Indoeasy Scent Website — static site, deployed to a personal VPS via rsync

scripts.seo:all: npm run seo:covers && npm run seo:images && npm run seo:inject && npm run seo:validate
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:dry && npm run deploy:live

comment: Replace VPS_IP in the deploy scripts, or export DEPLOY_HOST and use rsync directly. See docs/MIGRATION-VPS.md.
